focused_merge.protocol: Each image contains its checkout's runtime and the identical shared merge_sources.vibe. Compilation uses one literal active root/compiler/output path. Every runtime sample starts a fresh Node process at one literal module path, with 128 virtual modules plus an entry, one group per module. A cold merge precedes 16 warm merges; guest Profiler counters delimit each region. Bump RC=0; no Fs authority or persistent cache. A/A controls precede AB/BA/AB pairs for shared/default, shared/alpha, DB/default and DB/alpha cases. Runs must be isolated from other compiler/test jobs.

filesystem_own_source.protocol: Each compiler compiles its own checkout snapshot. Snapshots move through the SAME literal root, compiler, cache and output paths, avoiding path-length and path-content bias. Isolated caches per lane and round; cold then warm in fresh Node processes; AB/BA/AB order; RC=0; compiler/test runs isolated.

filesystem_same_source_ast.protocol: Both compilers compile the same candidate snapshot; outputs must be identical across compilers. Snapshots move through the SAME literal root, compiler, cache and output paths, avoiding path-length and path-content bias. Isolated caches per lane and round; cold then warm in fresh Node processes; AB/BA/AB order; RC=0; compiler/test runs isolated.
